templates.name: Boundary Survey
templates.description: Language for a general boundary survey for residential properties.

language.content: White Point Survey will prepare a boundary survey in conformance with Chapter 5J-17, Florida Administrative Codes, pursuant to Chapter 472, Florida Statutes. The survey will be tied to the Florida State Plane Coordinate System based on {coordinate_system}. The survey will show located or set property corners. {improvements_located} No elevations will be collected or shown on the survey. The survey will show the property's relation to the FEMA floodplain. The results of the survey will be represented by a survey map being either digitally signed or physically signed by a license surveyor. {additional_language}

templates.name: Tree Location Survey
templates.description: Language for a general tree location survey for both residential and commercial properties.

language.content: White Point Survey will prepare a tree location survey in conformance with Chapter 5J-17, Florida Administrative Codes, pursuant to Chapter 472, Florida Statutes. The survey will be tied to the Florida State Plane Coordinate System based on {coordinate_system}. The survey will show the location of trees with a diameter at breast height (DBH) of {dbh} inches or greater. Only the common name of each tree will be referenced on the survey, unless additional information is provided to the surveyor prior to the survey being signed. The results of the survey will be represented by a survey map being either digitally signed or physically signed by a license surveyor. {additional_language}
